standard_prerequisites.name: On an affine scheme the derived category of modules identifies with the derived category of quasi-coherent sheaves by the tilde construction, compatible with tensor product

standard_prerequisites.name: A complex of modules with tor amplitude in [a, b] is represented by a complex of flat modules concentrated in [a, b]
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the flat representative whose sheafification witnesses the tor amplitude of E.

standard_prerequisites.name: A complex of flat sheaves concentrated in degrees [a, b] has tor amplitude in [a, b]
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes the forward direction of (1) from the flat representative.

core_obligations: Note (2) follows from (1) directly, and the equivalence D(A) = D_QCoh(X) of Lemma affine-compare-bounded is used throughout without further mention (proof lines 2520-2525).

Forward direction of (1): if M^bullet has tor amplitude in [a, b], it is isomorphic in D(A) to a complex K^bullet of flat A-modules with K^i = 0 outside [a, b] (More on Algebra, Lemma tor-amplitude); then E is isomorphic to the sheafified K^bullet, each term of which is flat over O_X, so E has tor amplitude in [a, b] by Cohomology, Lemma tor-amplitude (proof lines 2525-2533).

Converse direction of (1): if E has tor amplitude in [a, b] then E is bounded, so M^bullet lies in K^-(A); replace M^bullet by a bounded above complex of free modules via a projective resolution; then for any A-module N the derived tensor E tensor^L N~ identifies with the sheafification of M^bullet tensor_A N, and the vanishing of the cohomology sheaves of the left hand side forces M^bullet to have tor amplitude in [a, b] (proof lines 2534-2549).
proof_roadmap: Reduce (2) to (1) and fix the affine dictionary (proof lines 2520-2525).
Prove the forward direction via a flat representative and its sheafification (proof lines 2525-2533).
Prove the converse via projective resolution and the tensor compatibility of the tilde correspondence (proof lines 2534-2549).
